items.title: Bob Haggart interviewed by Michael Woods, Clinton, New York, September 22, 1995
items.q: It was just in a © Fillius Jazz Archive -14- Hardee’s commercial, you know the Hardee’s Restaurant chain?

ctx.x: Did it ever get, finally get written down?

Well I’ve written it out for people, yeah. In fact there’s a guy that contacted me, wanted to make an arrangement for his, he had a girl band. And I forget the name of his band but it’s a new group. They were all women. And they have a terrific bass player and they do “Big Noise,” but they don’t do it like I did it. They have their own way of doing it and it’s a lot of stuff, and it starts off with the sticks on the bass, and then there’s sticks on the guitar, and then on the tom tom. It’s all percussive, the…
Hardee’s commercial, you know the Hardee’s Restaurant chain? And so I got a nice fat check for that.
